title: Cross-Selling and Upselling Strategies for Small Businesses - Funds for Companies

facts.fact: Cross-selling involves offering customers additional products or services that complement their initial purchase.
facts.quote: Cross-selling involves offering customers additional products or services that complement their initial purchase.

facts.fact: Upselling focuses on persuading customers to purchase a more expensive version of a product or service they are already considering.
facts.quote: upselling focuses on persuading customers to purchase a more expensive version of a product or service they are already considering.

facts.fact: The page gives an example of a bundled offer in which a travel agency packages flights, accommodation, and activities at a discounted rate compared with buying each component separately.
facts.quote: a travel agency might offer a package deal that includes flights, accommodation, and activities at a discounted rate compared to purchasing each component separately.
